title: Testing and Quality Assurance
learning_outcomes: Explain the main ideas in Testing and Quality Assurance and correctly use the key terms in context.
Build or inspect a minimal Solidity example that demonstrates the lesson concepts.
Test representative failure cases and describe version, security, or operational assumptions where relevant.

overview_visual.alt_text: A two-column ordered roadmap for Module 15: Testing and Quality Assurance; it lists all 16 source-syllabus lesson topics by number.
overview_visual.caption: Module 15 roadmap: Why Smart Contract Testing Is Different; Unit Testing Fundamentals; Testing State Changes and Function Outputs; Testing Reverts and Custom Errors; Testing Events and Emitted Logs; Arrange-Act-Assert Test Design; Test Fixtures and Reusable Setup; Mock Contracts and Test Doubles; Integration Testing; Fuzz Testing and Randomized Inputs; Invariant Testing and State Properties; Fork-Based Testing Against Existing Networks; Negative Testing and Adversarial Inputs; Regression Testing and Reproducing Failures; Code Coverage and Test Gaps; Test Reporting, Trace Analysis, and Continuous Integration. Work through the topics in order, then implement a small example and verify assumptions.
